title: Carrie
subtitle: (season 1)
review: Oh my god you've got to see the hottest new viral video! It's of a small girl being screamed at as she cowers on the floor in terror. What great content. I can see how this would spread through the school. This has made me realise I've never seen a believable viral media trend in fiction. {Nathan For You} came close with the goat in the water. I think the issue is that, in screenplays, characters have to explicitly tell each other that a video is going viral; In reality nobody has to say that out loud. This series reminded me a lot of {Stranger Things}, partly because the Eleven character is based on Carrie, but also because this show is targeted squarely at the same audience. It's a show both about, and for, teenage girls. There's a good dose of {Euphoria} coursing through it too. In each episode they find an even crazier modern way to torture Carrie, and I found that very funny and addictive to watch. Maybe, like the other Gen Z streaming hits I mentioned, its reputation will be trashed by unnecessary and repetitive extra seasons. Maybe it will age poorly. But at the moment it's very entertaining TV junk food. Turn your brain off and enjoy the bitching. Maybe scroll on your phone a bit as you watch; check out some cringe TikToks.
